1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物” Formula: Subject + 看到 / 发现 + person + 正在 + verb Correct: “神农正在路上走，看到很多人正在吃一些植物。” “一看” usually means “as soon as one looks” and needs a following result clause. Here, “看到” is more natural for describing what Shennong saw.
